name: android-mumu-arknights
description: Android development and automation on the MuMu 12 Arknights edition.

sdk_path.description: Optional Android SDK root directory. When empty, falls back to ANDROID_HOME, ANDROID_SDK_ROOT, or common system paths.

api_level.description: Android API level used when generating projects.

build_tools_version.description: Android SDK build-tools version used in installation guidance.

jdk_major.description: JDK major version used for preflight checks and installation guidance.

mumu_instance.description: MuMu Player instance index (0 for the first instance).

prefer_mumu.description: When true and no serial is given, start or reuse MuMu before any fallback device.
